item.text: {"analysis":"The trial executed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 to 0.500, versus 0.515 for the preceding ConvRec and 0.505 for the baseline. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.550, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.530, Electronics 0.370, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.550. Relative to the preceding ConvRec, Electronics improved by 0.015 while CDs_and_Vinyl declined by 0.020. Causal mean memory did not improve the overall objective in this trial; these results do not establish the cause or statistical significance of the regression.","code_summary":"One independently trained ConvRec per category uses tied item embeddings and learned item biases, four causal convolution blocks with dilations 1/2/4/8, and two-head causal attention. A new memory branch projects and normalizes causal prefix means of nonpadding embeddings, then fuses memory with backbone features through a learned sigmoid gate before final normalization. Training retains sampled-softmax loss and selects one checkpoint per category by validation HR@10. The generated predictor strictly reconstructs that architecture and loads one checkpoint per category. Diagnostics check causal pooling, padding, gradients, and saved/exported score parity. No ensemble or separately fitted scorer is used."}
